episodes.189944: Weakening northeast winds and mostly clear skies, ahead of a shear line near Alamagan in the far northern Mariana Islands, created conditions just right for a rare dust devil during the morning of March 20th.

events.narrative: Video of the Dust Devil was caught on a backyard security camera and was provide to WFO Guam. A team from WFO Guam also went to the property and interviewed nearby residents Primary damage found was to a couple of canopies that was dead-in street between two homes. Some of the legs of the both canopy were tied to cinder blocks, but part of one the canopy's metal frames ended up being tossed on top of the one story house is was next to. Total property damage was estimated to be around $200 USD.
